children: Centene reaffirmed full-year 2026 GAAP diluted EPS guidance of greater than $3.11 and adjusted diluted EPS guidance of greater than $4.80.
Centene will present at the Deutsche Bank 2026 Healthcare Summit on Sept. 16 and meet investors through the week of Sept. 21.
Management will discuss business and financial results and reaffirm 2026 GAAP diluted EPS > $3.11.
Management will also reaffirm 2026 adjusted diluted EPS > $4.80, excluding specified non-GAAP items.
Live audio webcast available and replay on Centene's investor website; non-GAAP reconciliations referenced in prior July 28 press release.
